evidence.successBody: Your evidence has entered the Ramona & René permanent archives. There is no undo button. There never was.

evidence.errorTooLargeVideo: That video is a cinematic epic (over 50 MB). Trim it to a shorter clip and resubmit to the archives.
evidence.errorTooLargeImage: That photo is enormous. Even the archives have limits (20 MB). Please try a smaller one.
evidence.errorUnsupported: The archives don't recognise this file format. Photos (JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF) and videos (MP4, MOV, WebM) only.
evidence.errorRateLimited: Easy there, official wedding paparazzo. You're uploading too fast — give it a few minutes.
evidence.footer: All evidence is permanently archived by Ramona & René · 12 June 2027

honeymoon.title: Wedding Gift
honeymoon.body:
Your presence, your good mood and your desire to celebrate our union are all we wish for on this special day.
We are not doing a wedding gift list, but if you would like to give us a small gift, we are planning a trip for our honeymoon.
You can contribute to our project either online by clicking on the Contribute button below, or through the gift box available at the reception venue on the wedding day.

parking.title: Getting Here & Away
parking.subtitle: Parking & Travelling back to Bucharest after the party
parking.body: The parking is located 100 metres from the restaurant Garuda By Phoenix Cernica. Our teams and staff will help guide you and park your car. Uber and Bolt are widely available to travel back to Bucharest after the party.
